numerical_proposal_basis: 1000 ppm rounds above the observed short-window possible relative-rate interval, not a hardware certification. A 30s holdover widens the observed maximum 17500us interval by at most 60000us under that explicit assumption, remaining below proposed 100000us. Refresh is every 10s; failed refresh holds immediately. 30000000us is the explicit maximum checkpoint interval, never grant validity. All numerical values are proposed, not selected production policy. Final reviewed code also widens the observation RTT by approved drift (up to 11us for the observed 10488us RTT at proposed 1000ppm); the proposed 100000us guard still covers this measured scenario. Raw discovery interval widths use nominal QPC elapsed.
